items_written_here.title: Make the existing assurance execute and block: land the phantom fi_min gate, enrol the local-only gates and never-run suites per-PR, restore the nightly, then add emulation-FI and glyph-leak regression nets

Close the NS clock/power/tamper levers (RCC/PWR/SYSCFG/TAMP secure attribution), then add PVD-5 over BOR-3 with an SRAM-only zeroize, pin BOR_LEV in the ship profile, and run ADC4 analog watchdogs as a log-only slow supply/temperature tamper

Fail-stop memory integrity: MSPLIM with a re-basing fault trampoline, a decoded and region-scoped ECC NMI, secrets in an ECC-on secure bank, and the SRAM option bits pinned into the ship profile before RDP-2 freezes them

Fault and tamper forensics with lockout-time persistence: capture CFSR/SFSR/SFAR/PC, TAMP SR, TZIC SR, reset cause and the PIN-attempt reason ring into a wipe-surviving public record and render the reason after the FSBL fingerprint

clusters_written_elsewhere.title: Fault response without attempt-charging: zeroize-then-reset in the glitch-halt sink, a written verdict-vs-availability rule, sparse phase words, PIN-scrambler RNG fail-closed, and diagnostics-only SE fault counting

Land the fixed FI-delay source on master, add dispatcher-entry jitter, then a measurement-gated always-on RDI on the existing secure SysTick (no timing canary)
Erased-tail check on the selected slot (FSBL boot + CMD_FW_COMMIT), Trezor check_image_contents shape; optionally widen the 8-word fingerprint to the signed manifest digest
